story_type: elderly sailor, sailboat aground in breaking waves
hook: Waves broke over his sailboat. He was 73 and stuck on the rocks.
narration: Waves were breaking right over this sailboat, pinned on the rocks in Lake Superior.
The man aboard was seventy-three years old, aground off Manitou Island, Michigan.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk from Air Station Traverse City came in low over the wreck.
Its rescue swimmer was lowered onto the deck as the boat rocked against the shore.
A sailboat's mast can snag a hoist cable, so crews often pick people up from the water beside the boat.
[short pause] Then the basket came down.
outcome: The 73-year-old was hoisted into the Jayhawk and flown safely to Houghton, Michigan.
title: 73 and aground in Lake Superior waves
description:
On Sept. 29, 2018, a Coast Guard Air Station Traverse City MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted a 73-year-old man off a sailboat aground near Manitou Island in Lake Superior and flew him to Houghton, Michigan.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Traverse City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/664732/lake-superior-rescue
